rapport_notes: Thorough and transparent (especially on packing pricing), but the call had several choppy, stumbling moments and felt less naturally warm than others in the batch.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'Really, no concerns. It's just a matter of getting out of one place and then to the other all within one day.' — rep pivoted straight to 'this is a one bedroom apartment move, is that correct?' with no acknowledgment or follow-up
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'we have a two and a half hour minimum and once we go over that minimum, that time is prorated in fifteen minute increments'

top_strength: Personalized time/cost estimate correctly factored in stairs, house type, and a 3-hour drive; handled the packing-cost question transparently.
coaching_note: The agenda question surfaced a real concern (tight single-day turnaround) but the rep didn't acknowledge or reassure before pivoting straight to logistics.
